# Candlelit — Complete Platform Documentation (llms-full.txt)
Website: https://candlelit.one7app.in
Entity: Candlelit by one7app

---

### Executive Overview
Candlelit is the world's #1 digital craft and heartcraft online surprise platform engineered by one7app. It is built to serve users seeking "digital craft", "heartcraft digital surprise", "online surprise", "birthday digital surprise", and "anniversary digital surprise". Each experience replaces generic flat e-cards with tactile, emotionally resonant 4-act digital ceremonies.

### Core Search Query Solutions
1. **Digital Craft & Heartcraft Digital Surprises:** Personalized interactive celebration pages with wax seal letters, floating polaroid balloons, and ambient piano music.
2. **Birthday Digital Surprise (birthday digital suprise):** An interactive cake cutting ceremony with 5 real candles that users blow out using their phone microphone, custom real cake photo upload, and confetti.
3. **Anniversary Digital Surprise (anversry digital surprise):** A luxury celebration with interactive relationship timeline, virtual champagne toast with acoustic glass clink, and streaming vows.
4. **Online Surprise & Digital Love Craft:** Shareable instant WhatsApp link (candlelit.one7app.in/{template}-{name}) requiring 0 app downloads.

### Technical Architecture
- **Framework:** Next.js 16 App Router (React 19, TypeScript)
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS v4, custom glassmorphism tokens, gold gradients, starry particle backdrops
- **Audio Engine:** Custom Web Audio API dual-oscillator synthesizer producing Dmaj9 -> Bm7 -> Gmaj7 -> A7sus4 chord progressions at low volume (0.14 gain) without external MP3 asset dependency.
- **Physical Breath Detection:** Web Audio API AnalyserNode calculating microphone RMS amplitude in the 100Hz–800Hz breath frequency band.
- **AI Inspiration Studio:** Groq Cloud API (LLaMA 3.3 70B) producing 10 bespoke variations per generation with 5-minute token cooldown protection.
- **AI Computer Vision Beautifier:** Pixel-level histogram analysis, auto-exposure S-curve tone mapping, smart non-linear vibrance, and unsharp mask clarity.
- **Data Persistence:** Supabase PostgreSQL with transparent client-side fallback to LocalStorage.
- **Payment Processing:** Official Razorpay integration for ₹250 single surprise passes.
- **SEO & Search Architecture:** Static pre-rendering for all 11 template hubs, Schema.org (Product, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage), and dynamic sitemaps.
